item.title: uhd-rfsoc: Bringing Off-the-Shelf RFSoC Boards to Unmodified UHD Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Next-generation wireless research relies on software-defined radios (SDRs) with more channels and larger bandwidth. The USRP family is one of the most widely used SDR platforms, an

Next-generation wireless research relies on software-defined radios (SDRs) with more channels and larger bandwidth. The USRP family is one of the most widely used SDR platforms, and much of the wireless software ecosystem is built on top of the USRP hardware driver (UHD). However, each USRP model comes with a fixed channel count, bandwidth, and streaming capability. Off-the-shelf radio frequency system-on-chip (RFSoC) boards, on the other hand, integrate up to 16 analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) and 16 digital-to-analog converters (DACs) operating at several gigasamples per second (GS/s), but existing UHD applications cannot directly use them. We present uhd-rfsoc, an open-source FPGA design and host software stack that turns these boards, including the 16-channel ZCU216 and the RFSoC 4x2, into standard UHD devices without modifying UHD. Through standard UHD calls, applications can configure the carrier frequency, channel count, the per-channel I/Q sample rate, and the wire format. uhd-rfsoc combines timestamped, flow-controlled sample transport in the FPGA with data plane development kit (DPDK) packet processing and vectorized sample conversion on x86 and Arm hosts. item.title: f-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning m

Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning meaningful representations of normality. Recent work has applied large language models (LLMs) to this problem by serializing table rows as text sequences, yet these approaches rely on one-shot supervised fine-tuning that offers limited signal to tighten the model's description of normality. We propose DiSPaT, a self-play fine-tuning framework that strengthens the model's understanding of normal data. Building on the theoretical foundation of f-divergence minimization, we derive a tight approximation connecting our training objective to reducing the distributional gap between real normal data and model-generated samples. DiSPaT operates through an alternating optimization: at each iteration, the current policy generates synthetic samples that serve as pseudo-anomalies, while a critic discriminator learns to distinguish these from real normal samples; this signal drives policy updates that progressively align the model distribution with the true normal-data distribution. Extensive experiments on diverse benc…

item.title: Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：NCCL 等 GPU 通信库用 SM 做数据搬运与同步，拖慢重叠计算且代价随互连带宽增长，能否完全不占 SM 完成通信？

方法：Zero-SM NCCL——不启动任何 SM kernel 完成 scale-up 域内外的通信：用 CUDA stream 内存操作同步、copy engine 在域内异步搬数、流序 CPU proxy 驱动网络 RDMA；支持 AllGather/AlltoAll 等数据搬运集合以及单边 ncclPutSignal/ncclWaitSignal API。

关键数字：GB200 NVL72 与 B200 NVL8 上 AllGather 带宽最高比 NCCL 传统 SM kernel 高 1.36×，重叠 GEMM 的中位减速从 33% 降到 4%（每操作延迟更高）；Megatron-LM 训练中 FSDP 加速最多 3.5%、单边 put 加速流水并行最多 15%；但小消息与 host 受限负载反而吃亏。

为什么值得看：SM-free 通信的系统指南、含明确适用边界，NVL72 时代训练栈值得一读。

原文：Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication

item.title: Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no archit

Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the gain. item.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network t

Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for globa

Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：晶圆级加速器（WSE）通过数十万 PE 提供巨大算力，但模板化映射强加固定几何布局、常让计算与内存资源利用不足，如何实现自由映射？

方法：WaferTetris 系统——Tetris 式策略灵活打包计算、提升 PE 利用率与可用内存容量，同时保留 PE-task 代码；基于递归的吞吐模型捕捉 branch-and-join 依赖以指导空间并行；逐色门控的架构模型让现有 FPGA place-and-route 算法执行 WSE 路由约束。

关键数字：Cerebras WSE-3 上 LLM 解码吞吐最高为模板化自动映射基线的 4.42×；相比手工优化的 WaferLLM 支持 1.8× 上下文长度（LLaMA3.1-8B 80k vs 44k），匹配上下文下每用户吞吐持平或更高（最高 1.10×）。

为什么值得看：晶圆级加速器摆脱模板映射约束的系统方法，WSE 编程范式的重要突破。

原文：WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators

item.title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a differe

We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：线性注意力 LLM 用固定大小循环状态替代增长的 KV cache，边缘 FPGA 上状态可能超过片上内存而必须分页到外部内存——分页是否主导解码成本？

方法：在 Agilex 5 FPGA 上构建计算一个完整层的硬件 tile（3.69 亿参数混合 Gated DeltaNet 模型）并分页其循环状态；tile 是三模多播网格中的一个节点；对照浮点测量定点算术误差，并检查硬件与定点参考逐位一致。

关键数字：模型状态需 6.2 MiB，器件块内存仅 0.87 MiB；分页每解码 token 增加 26.0 MB 内存流量、至多占总量的 11.2%；75 MHz 板上该层单 token 11.15 ms，权重矩阵-向量积约占 62%、状态阶段（含分页）占 13%；仿真 18 个循环层全部一致，板上 6 个 build 通过全部 30 次 64-token 与 2 次 1,024-token 运行。

为什么值得看：用 RTL 到硅的硬证据回答「状态分页是否瓶颈」——答案是否定的，权重搬运才是限制。

原文：The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon

item.title: The Exact Stabilization Time of Self-Stabilizing Coloring: Mean, Variance, and Distribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical se

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical self-stabilizing $Delta+1$ coloring algorithm with vertices activated at random, one at a time (the random central daemon). Considering the number of color changes as a random variable, we study its mean, variance and, on several families of graphs, its exact distribution. The analysis rests on a reduction: a vertex changes color, at most once, exactly when it is not a local maximum of a uniformly random labeling of the vertices, maxima being taken among the neighbors that share its initial color (the monochrome initial configuration is the slowest case). What can be predicted depends on what is known of the graph. The degree distribution (the view at distance one) gives the mean. The variance needs the view at distance two, in particular the triangles, and the full law needs the whole graph. We give closed-form results, from monochrome and from uniformly random initial configurations, on paths, cycles, random trees, Erdős-R{é}nyi graphs and bipartite random graphs. From a monochrome start, the mean stays w…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical se

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical self-stabilizing $Delta+1$ coloring algorithm with vertices activated at random, one at a time (the random central daemon). Considering the number of color changes as a random variable, we study its mean, variance and, on several families of graphs, its exact distribution. The analysis rests on a reduction: a vertex changes color, at most once, exactly when it is not a local maximum of a uniformly random labeling of the vertices, maxima being taken among the neighbors that share its initial color (the monochrome initial configuration is the slowest case). What can be predicted depends on what is known of the graph. The degree distribution (the view at distance one) gives the mean. The variance needs the view at distance two, in particular the triangles, and the full law needs the whole graph. We give closed-form results, from monochrome and from uniformly random initial configurations, on paths, cycles, random trees, Erdős-R{é}nyi graphs and bipartite random graphs. From a monochrome start, the mean stays w…

item.title: TailGuard-GDS: Tail-Safe Control of GPU Storage Data Movement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 运行时在关键路径上搬移 NVMe↔GPU 状态，GDS 去掉 host 中转，但八块 H100 实测显示它对语义相同的 GPU-buffer 操作并非总是尾延迟最优——带宽赢家与尾延迟赢家可能不一致，如何选？

方法：TailGuard-GDS 运行时——按应用阶段选择语义等价的搬运方案；profile 不同 backend/请求形状/放置，在阶段约束下最小化 GPU 可见尾延迟，条件变化时重新决策；资源复用让策略查找与切换开销在微秒级。

关键数字：集成 PyTorch FSDP 与 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 后，FSDP step p95 降 18.4%、GPU 空闲 p95 降 25.3%（vs 最强固定路径）；五个八卡 ZeRO-3 负载 step p95 相对固定 host staging 降 7.9–24.6%、相对固定 GDS 降 28.4–42.6%；相对调优的 DeepSpeed AIO 再降 5.6%、估计吞吐提升 6.1%。

为什么值得看：存储↔GPU 数据移动按阶段自适应选路，大模型训练 I/O 优化的实用方向。

原文：TailGuard-GDS: Tail-Safe Control of GPU Storage Data Movement

item.title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 同步共置 RL 后训练因长尾 rollout 严重利用不足——推理引擎空等长尾 rollout 或以低效小批量 decode，如何在不破坏 on-policy 语义的前提下恢复资源利用率？

方法：TIDE RL 训练系统——长尾 rollout 完成期间动态把 rollout GPU 改用于训练；动态在推理引擎间迁移 rollout 提升解码吞吐；自适应迁移策略自动决定重利用 rollout 资源的时机，无需针对配置手工调参。

关键数字：相对共置系统端到端加速最高 1.36×，胜过全部评估的 on-policy 基线，达到最优吞吐的 97%。

为什么值得看：LLM RL 后训练利用率低下的系统级修复，训练集群排产直接受益。

原文：TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning

item.title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the av

Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the availability of suitable data. By contrast, time-series data are abundant and easier to collect. Since observations at each location form a time series, this motivates a natural question: can abundant time-series data enhance STFMs when spatio-temporal observations are scarce? To bridge this gap, we propose T2ST, a data-efficient training framework that augments limited spatio-temporal observations with selected auxiliary time series and transfers knowledge from a frozen time-series foundation model. Our key insight is that temporal pattern learning can benefit from abundant external time series, while spatial dependency learning remains grounded in real spatio-temporal observations. Guided by this insight, T2ST retrieves matched sequences to reinforce sparsely observed temporal patterns and selects reliable complementary sequences to broaden temporal coverage. item.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：本地 LLM 服务面临两种新压力——单设备上多 agent 共享一个交互式模型；跨设备上开发者拥有多台不同厂商机器但各自只服务单运行时、大部分时间闲置，如何统一？

方法：Superfluid 开源本地 LLM server——单设备用隔离 worker 进程驱动 llama.cpp/MLX/BaseRT，一个调度器把交互请求排在 agent 工作之前、公共 prompt 只计算一次、每个 token 先写持久日志再达客户端；跨设备把机器群变成单一 API 端点，异构硬件按实测速度分活，可随时加入/失败而不丢请求。

关键数字：Apple M5 Pro 上 Qwen3.8-27B，8 个 agent 工作时聊天首 token 1.5s（llama-server/Ollama/mlx_lm.server 为 291–612s）；6 台三厂商机器 64 模拟用户 1 小时服务 5,041 请求全部完成，吞吐 112→534 tok/s、中位首 token 99→12s；12 台 Mac Studio M3 Ultra 上 384 agent 的 38,563 请求以 10,656 tok/s 零失败完成。

为什么值得看：本地多机 LLM 服务的开源方案，边缘/私有部署团队可直接使用。

原文：Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference

item.title: Super-Analysis for Aggressive yet Scalable Compiler Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：激进编译优化两极分化——常规优化器毫秒级但启发式漏机会，superoptimizer 合成更快代码但要数小时、只限小 kernel 离线用；能否取中间路线？

方法：基于 solver 的 super-analysis——用昂贵的 SMT 分析，变换仍保持常规、完全避免程序合成；实例化 ODeSSy LLVM pass，证明 sanitizer trap 与原生语言安全检查不可达并删除；guard synthesis 对并非全输入死代码的检查合成廉价不变式守卫、克隆无检查快循环。

关键数字：一个机制服务四种前端语言且各有加速，含 Julia GEMM 3.78×；Swift Base64 编码器 1.44×、Julia LZ77 压缩器 4.01×；相比 Souper 删除更多安全检查且显著更快，可作为在线编译 pass。

为什么值得看：SMT 分析进入常规编译流水线的新范式，安全与性能兼得。

原文：Super-Analysis for Aggressive yet Scalable Compiler Optimization

item.title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster

e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. We add a second condition, based on the distance between centres: a small cluster is removed only if its centre is close to another centre, relative to a running estimate of the mean squared error. When a centre equals the mean of its points, this squared distance is an upper bound on the average increase in squared error, per point of the cluster, caused by removing the centre. item.title: Sample-efficient prediction of high-entropy alloy strength through outcome-aware robust sequential learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of high-entropy alloy (HEA) strength can guide composition and processing decisions; however, obtaining tensile-test data for HEAs can be costly and experimenta

Accurate prediction of high-entropy alloy (HEA) strength can guide composition and processing decisions; however, obtaining tensile-test data for HEAs can be costly and experimentally demanding. This study proposes Robust Outcome-aware Sequential Experimentation for High-Entropy Alloys (ROSE-HEA), a sample-efficient framework for predicting ultimate tensile strength (UTS) from alloy composition and processing conditions. Its acquisition policy anticipates how possible UTS outcomes update predictions and the support for complementary Gaussian process (GP) descriptions. It then reassesses the worst-case expected predictive risk remaining across a reference domain to select informative candidates. A retrospective evaluation on 501 HEA records compares ROSE-HEA with expected-improvement (EI) and upper-confidence-bound (UCB) Bayesian optimization (BO), random GP sampling, and eight conventional regressors across 30 matched runs with shared initial observations and test conditions. Starting from 25 initial observations and acquiring 100 additional responses, ROSE-HEA achieves the lowest mean root-mean-square error (RMSE), at 152.84 MPa, and the highest mean R^2, at 0.7443. item.title: Sample-Efficient Control of Magnetoconvective Flows via Differentiable Simulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) fluid flows are central to demanding engineering applications, most prominently fusion blanket cooling, where flow control is a promising tool to optimize

Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) fluid flows are central to demanding engineering applications, most prominently fusion blanket cooling, where flow control is a promising tool to optimize key properties such as heat transfer. While active flow control (AFC) has recently advanced through machine learning, its application to MHD flows remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present $φ$-PICT, a novel differentiable GPU-accelerated MHD solver targeted at AFC. We validate $φ$-PICT against MHD benchmarks and demonstrate its high computational efficiency. Integrated into FluidGym, $φ$-PICT enables sample-efficient gradient-based algorithms to improve heat transfer by $>25$% and allows optimizers to achieve $10^3\times$ higher accuracy in inverse design than black-box methods. $φ$-PICT is publicly available at https://github.com/upb-sciml/phiPICT.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SIMTurn: Lightweight Divergent Subgroup Scheduling for Intra-Warp Synchronization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：基于栈的重汇合 SIMT 执行对发散路径固定串行化，会死锁依赖 warp 内同步的程序——自旋子组可能挡住持资源的兄弟子组；ITS 可解但硬件开销大，能否轻量实现？

方法：SIMTurn 轻量编译器-硬件机制——编译器在潜在阻塞循环插入 yield 指令，配一个有界的可恢复子组池；调度器让等待的子组让位给可进展的兄弟，无需每线程独立程序计数器；在开源 Vortex GPGPU 的编译器、模拟器与 RTL 上实现并评估。

关键数字：相对 IPDOM 仅 17–24% 的调度器面积开销（ITS 为 39–91%）；无跨子组进展需求的负载离 IPDOM 8% 以内；有真实跨子组并行时紧跟 ITS，比软件串行化 IPDOM 基线最快 2.7×。

为什么值得看：warp 内同步死锁的轻量硬件解法，SIMT 前沿且开源可复现。

原文：SIMTurn: Lightweight Divergent Subgroup Scheduling for Intra-Warp Synchronization

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

item.title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks: Architectures, Trainability, and Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalabil

Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. We then review symmetry and geometric inductive biases (permutation, rotation, and Lorentz), the results on expressivity, trainability, noise, and scalability, and applications in high-energy physics, chemistry, finance, healthcare, earth observation, and transportation. item.title: Protection-Oriented Assessment of Machine Learning-Based Fault Detection in Power Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML)-based fault detectors are increasingly proposed for power system protection, yet aggregate metrics can obscure the consequences of false and missed trips. We

Machine learning (ML)-based fault detectors are increasingly proposed for power system protection, yet aggregate metrics can obscure the consequences of false and missed trips. We present a protection-oriented assessment of three ML detectors and a sequence-current reference on PROTECT-90, comprising 9,022 simulated fault episodes on a 90 kV double-circuit line. The assessment combines five window conditions, causal window-end labelling, episode-grouped cross-validation, and operating-point selection under a fixed security budget. It reports security, dependability, detection timing, decision margins, and episode-level nuisance assertions. Gradient-boosted trees, a convolutional neural network, and logistic regression achieve AUC-ROC values above 0.999, yet at a security budget of $10^{-3}$ their developed-fault missed-trip rates range from 0.007% to 1.99%. Post-clearing false-trip rates of approximately 0.12-0.16% per window coexist with nuisance assertions in 11.3-19.1% of episodes. Among the analysed physical descriptors, missed trips are most consistently associated with higher fault resistance within the sampled range. item.title: Process Mining-Enabled Federated Anomaly Detection for the Industrial IoT
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In pract

While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In practice, industrial IoT plants often operate under varying conditions and experience diverse environmental phenomena, resulting in significant heterogeneity in the monitored time series. In such settings, standard federated learning approaches fail to perform nuanced aggregation that accounts for these cross-node differences, ultimately leading to increased false positive rates. In this paper, we propose a process mining approach to evaluate the similarity of local node data against a reference provided by a global node. The global node utilizes these similarity metrics to dynamically weight local models during aggregation, producing personalized updates distributed across the network. We evaluate our approach using industrial IoT time-series data collected from manufacturing plants operating under distinct conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our process mining-enabled federated anomaly detection pipeline achieves superior performance, yielding a 46.52% and 11.99% relative improvement in F1-scor…

item.title: PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 生成的生产代码正确性不足以判断是否适合反复使用——还取决于时间、内存与能耗成本，但现有代码生成基准几乎只评正确性，性能基准覆盖语言少、很少测能耗。

方法：PERFARENA 开源可复现竞技场——按生成代码的性能跨多语言多竞赛排名 LLM；在 Unix 主机执行各 LLM 的解，同时报告正确性、延迟、峰值内存与能耗；正确性/性能 oracle、profiler 与代码生成流程均可插拔。

关键数字：两个竞赛：CLBGComp 10 个计算密集基准、LeetCodeComp 99 个可测延迟差异的 LeetCode 题；现有 13 个 SOTA LLM 的 9,455 个正确且已测解、7 种语言；got-6-astra 是唯一在延迟/能耗/峰值内存上无其他模型显著胜出的模型，解出 LeetCodeComp 99.7%、CLBGComp 100%。

为什么值得看：首个按代码性能而非正确性排名的公开竞技场，选模型多了一个量化维度。

原文：PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance

item.title: OrbitWeaver: LLM Agent Planning with Simulation Feedback for Optically Interconnected Orbital GPU Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjo

Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjoint GPUs can still contend on shared relay paths. Rank placement and communication priorities jointly affect this contention and the readiness of downstream computation. We present OrbitWeaver, an offline large language model (LLM) agent planner that jointly optimizes rank placement and communication order. Guided by communication structure, execution dependencies, and simulation feedback, the agent constructs and refines plans that coordinate shared-link access with computation progress. This coordination reduces contention and dependency blocking, shortening mean job completion time (JCT). Simulation experiments on optically interconnected orbital GPU clusters show that OrbitWeaver reduces aggregate mean JCT by 6.2-33.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baselines CASSINI, Crux, and Symphony. These results demonstrate the value of LLM-guided planning for efficient concurrent computing in orbital GPU clusters.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly inte

Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly integrated full-flow implementation. Yet, existing approaches struggle with the vast design space optimization (DSO) arising from diverse technology nodes, circuit designs, and varied constraints. The substantial runtime of physical-design tools further exacerbates this challenge, leaving industrial workflows heavily dependent on experienced engineers to navigate the design space and achieve power, performance, and area (PPA) targets, incurring significant engineering effort. We argue that large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning capabilities, enriched with distilled human design expertise, offer a promising path toward efficient and automated DSO. Unlike traditional algorithms, LLMs can interpret complex design contexts and naturally incorporate human expertise expressed in natural language for reasoning, acting, observing, and adapting throughout the design process, a capability that conventional optimization methods cannot exploit. item.title: Mutable Inference: Architecting LLM Accelerators for Inference-Time Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文 LLM 的全注意力成本随 token 增长，推理期学习（ITL）可在权重中保留所学、只需看近期固定窗口，但推理加速器假设权重固定，如何让加速器支持「边服务边学习」？

方法：Learning While Serving (LWS) 架构——Prediction（前向）与 Learning（反向+权重更新）共享计算硬件；利用注意力非矩阵操作留下的空闲矩阵容量；硬件级每层权重版本化让 Learning 发布更新、进行中的计算读旧版本；可恢复归约块让 Learning 内核跨碎片化空闲窗口运行并让位给 Prediction。

关键数字：TTT-E2E 3B 128K token 下保持 Prediction-only 吞吐，同时保留全新鲜 Learning 质量的 99.3%；9 个模型平均吞吐为串行执行的 1.6×、为此前最优共执行架构的 1.3×；RTL 综合显示 NPU 核心面积仅增 1.5%、无需额外 MAC 阵列。

为什么值得看：把推理期学习变成 LLM 加速器一等负载，架构思路清晰且有 RTL 验证。

原文：Mutable Inference: Architecting LLM Accelerators for Inference-Time Learning

item.title: MarathonTS: a benchmark of long synthetic time series from window assembly and long-series generators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool

Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool of short generated windows, which requires deciding which windows are taken, in what order, and how their seams are processed, or it can be produced directly by a long-series generator. This study presents MarathonTS, to our knowledge the first open benchmark that compares both families under one protocol. Every method produces a series of the same length on 9 open hourly datasets with 10 seeds. The series is evaluated by its fidelity to the real data (83 metrics in 12 groups, against three real references: train, validation and an out-of-time split), by its utility (models are trained on the synthetic series only and tested on real data, TSTR against TRTR, in 14 classification and regression tasks), by its memorisation of the training data and by its computational cost. item.title: INC-SRv6: In-Network Route Exploration and Fast Failover Using Segment Routing Headers in Dynamic UAV Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks require a network provisioning mechanism that guarantees delivery and latency quality of service (QoS) under dynamic conditions in next-gener

Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks require a network provisioning mechanism that guarantees delivery and latency quality of service (QoS) under dynamic conditions in next-generation airborne mesh networks by continuously learning and repairing multi-hop paths under rapid link turnover without flooding the control plane. This paper presents INC-SRv6, an in-network computing routing mechanism that repurposes the IPv6 Segment Routing Header (SRH) and its Segments Left (SL) pointer into a self-learning, fast-failover distributed control plane. Rather than treating the SRH as a static source-committed vector, INC-SRv6 uses the active SL pointer to partition the segment list in flight: slots ahead of SL provide capacity for hop-by-hop next-hop recording, while the suffix behind SL serves as an in-band multi-destination reachability vector. Through this dual-zone header discipline, transit routers extract distance-weighted reachability updates from arriving suffixes, gate admission by single-pass confidence with bounded binary probing, advance or reverse SL deterministically, and restore pre-transmission SRH state for local failover upon link loss. Rather than treating the SRH as a static source-committed vector, INC-SRv6 uses the active SL pointer to partition the segment list in flight: slots ahead of SL provide capacity for hop-by-hop next-hop recording, while the suffix behind SL serves as an in-band multi-destination reachability vector. Through this dual-zone header discipline, transit routers extract distance-weighted reachability updates from arriving suffixes, gate admission by single-pass confidence with bounded binary probing, advance or reverse SL deterministically, and restore pre-transmission SRH state for local failover upon link loss. item.title: Fuse-PINN: Combining Finite Element Methods and Physics-Informed Neural Networks to enable massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However

Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However, one frequent limitation is the inability of PINNs to scale out on High-Performance Computing architectures to address more ambitious challenges, particularly non-linear physics models with turbulent dynamics in large spatial domains. Typical studies restrain demonstrations to toy models with simple physics equations, few variables, and rarely any complex non-linear dynamics evolved over long timescales. Part of the AI community has even adopted the idea that "PINNs don't scale". This work proves otherwise. We present a mathematically robust formulation of Finite-Element-Method for Neural Networks (FEM-NN) implemented into a comprehensive, modular framework: Fuse-PINN. This formulation provides the basis for a sclable parallelisation of Physics-Informed Neural Networks on GPU-based HPC systems. Furthermore, an Energy Natural Gradient Descent optimiser is implemented to allow high-precision convergence. Fuse-PINN is demonstrated on physics models relevant to Magnetic Confinement Fusion, including non-line…

item.title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：TPU 上 MoE 推理受中间数据搬运与专家负载不均限制，如何联合优化专家计算、输出通信与负载均衡？

方法：Fuse-All MoE TPU kernel——融合 token 收集、专家投影、门控激活与输出写，专家计算中间量保留在片上；固定 token-slot 目标让调度与专家放置可变化而不破坏路由语义；PD 分离场景下用调度与专家重分配均衡 EP16 prefill，decode 用对称 EP8TP2 共享每芯片两 TensorCore 的活动专家计算。

关键数字：偏斜 EP16 prefill 负载的 kernel 运行时间从均衡参考的 2.3× 降至 1.09×；32–512 decode token 下对称 EP8TP2 相对融合 EP16 延迟最高降 21.3%；集成系统相对 Megablox EP16 基线吞吐最高提升 34.5%。

为什么值得看：TPU MoE 推理 kernel 的系统级优化，PD 分离部署可直接受益。

原文：Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs

item.title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error, but multi-step systems are ultimately evaluated by their final outputs. We study when these local gains survive composition. In specified linear regression models, we derive exact sharing and merging criteria by balancing variance savings against bias from sharing across roles with different target behavior. Under a common fixed linear propagation map, we characterize expected squared final-output risk, retaining error directions and correlations. We construct cases where sharing lowers average local error yet increases final-output error. Within this setting, we also identify when orthogonal full pooling with isotropic noise preserves every local improvement at the final output. For general routed computations, we derive conditional end-to-end error bounds that account for distribution shifts, errors in surrounding components, and changes in expert selection. Separately, we show that correct predictions and route labels alone do not establish that individual experts implement the attributed operations.…

item.title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models red

In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. item.title: EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：事件相机分割需要持久神经状态但输入稀疏，嵌入式实现中内存组织是核心约束，如何设计混合信号架构？

方法：EventSpikeSeg——GF180MCU 180nm CMOS 混合信号架构，常驻电容内存 + 共享模拟处理；25 种群脉冲编码-解码器含 143,824 个突触权重，但 440×640 分辨率下需 30,976,000 个膜状态；规定 5ms 时间步模型更新、数字事件/地址服务与 64 态电容组；表征覆盖 22 个模块族、74 个工作点。

关键数字：标称结果：神经元核心功率 41.711 微瓦、1.4 微秒单元读的正端能量 3.338 pJ、5ms 保持期选中态漂移 0.531 mV；软件 checkpoint 在 DSEC 六类 held-out 上平均 IoU 27.976%（非硬件精度）；单帧 SPICE 校准仿真 24.26% vs PyTorch 参考 26.22%。全网络物理运行、系统能耗与失配鲁棒性未验证。

为什么值得看：存算一体的端到端事件分割芯片设计，边界数据详实、未验证项如实标注。

原文：EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation

item.title: Elasticy: A Runtime-Reconfigurable Architecture for Dynamic Streams
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：可重构数据流加速器（RDA）对稠密规则张量高效，但对数据依赖、非均匀动态 shape 的不规则负载性能与效率骤降，如何支持动态流？

方法：Elasticy 动态可重构数据流加速器——用 streaming 与 tile 抽象把动态 shape 编码进流（rank-variable 表达式）；流内嵌重配置信息触发细粒度运行时调度；提出分布式链式流内存（DLSM）更有效利用片上内存、支持动态尺寸张量；重配置以 tile 流为粒度低频发生，动态维度处理开销极低。

关键数字：Llama 3-8B decode 层达 roofline 性能 92.6%（H100 为 69.7%）；DLSM 相比最优 cache 配置最多减少 61.4% 片外流量；分布式运行时调度器重叠依赖内核、内核对加速最高 1.42×；全层面积延迟积比传统空间加速器改善 6.34×–31.67×。

为什么值得看：动态 shape 负载的架构级解法，数据流加速器泛化到不规则负载的关键一步。

原文：Elasticy: A Runtime-Reconfigurable Architecture for Dynamic Streams

item.title: Efficient Poincaré Convolutions through Patch-Statistics Factorization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Published implementations of the Poincaré convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincaré ball before evaluating its score. We

Published implementations of the Poincaré convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincaré ball before evaluating its score. We show that the clipped score depends on each patch only through two statistics, its squared norm and its inner products with the filters, which a native convolution and a single-channel box filter compute directly. The factorized layer therefore evaluates the specified score exactly, without constructing ball-valued patches, and its single-precision outputs and gradients agree with double-precision evaluations at least as closely as those of the explicit reference. On an RTX A6000 under two versions of JAX, complete training updates of a Poincaré U-Net and a Poincaré ResNet-20 are 1.5 to 1.8 times faster than the faster of two explicit implementations that map patches to the ball (1.2 to 1.4 times against an explicit implementation that skips this mapping); on a V100, the gain over the gather-based one persists as the ResNet-20 is widened eightfold. In 15 paired training runs per task, updates are 2.0 and 1.8 times faster than a reference that follows the published execution order, with no consistent chan…

item.title: Disentangling Forgetting from Utility: Lightweight LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Null-Space Projection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific k

Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific knowledge without compromising general utility. However, prevailing fine-tuning-based unlearning methods struggle to achieve this balance, often suffering from computational inefficiency and unintended utility degradation due to the entangled nature of knowledge within model parameters. To disentangle forgetting from utility, we propose UUE, a theoretically grounded framework that reformulates unlearning as controllable model editing. First, UUE projects parameter updates into the orthogonal left null space of retained knowledge representations, strictly ensuring that the editing process causes minimal interference to the model's general capabilities. Second, distinct from targeted mapping, we introduce a convex untargeted objective that derives a closed-form analytical solution to effectively disrupt undesired knowledge by pushing forget-set embeddings toward their antipodal points. We implement UUE via lightweight, pluggable adapters (including a low-rank variant, UUE-L), enabling efficient deployment wi…

item.title: DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘设备视觉数据爆炸需要极致压缩，扩散编解码器质量好但计算重、占用 NPU 且 I/O 路径长，如何软硬协同解决？

方法：DiffusionSSD 跨层近数据处理框架——算法层 Dual-stage Diffusion（patchification + 单步扩散）降低计算成本；架构层提出 cUFS（计算通用闪存）+ LPDDR-PIM，把编解码完全卸载到数据侧、减少视觉数据搬运且无需重设计 SoC；系统层 Patch-Workload 协同感知调度。

关键数字：Dual-stage Diffusion 保持相近感知质量同时计算成本最高降 92.7%；相比 NPU+DRAM，cUFS+PIM 编码吞吐平均提升 2.32×；相比 SmartSSD 平均提升 2.91×。

为什么值得看：闪存+存内计算承载神经编解码的软硬协同设计，边缘视觉压缩的新路线。

原文：DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing

item.title: Differentially Private Federated Class-Incremental Learning for EEG Mental State Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth inje

Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth injected noise. Personal biosignal applications such as wearable EEG instead involve small federations of a handful of subjects, a regime whose interaction with formal client-level DP is largely uncharacterized. We study differentially private federated class-incremental learning in this small-cohort regime, combining a public EEG dataset with a custom four-channel MUSE 2 recording set into a K=5-client federation, and give a masked per-class training protocol that avoids degenerate gradients and missing negative supervision under class-incremental streaming. We propose FedEEG, combining Synaptic-Intelligence consolidation with a lagged adaptive FedProx term, and show it reduces catastrophic forgetting relative to FedAvg, FedProx, and a federated Learning-without-Forgetting baseline; on-device balanced-batch replay reduces mean forgetting by a further 56.7%. A class-scoping diagnosis yields $50.5\%\pm3.6\%$ accuracy with 6 seeds and 2.02 times chance. We also introduce head-scoped client-level DP, which prote…

item.title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-

A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. Early decay leaves a persistent weight-norm deficit, which keeps relative steps larger after the intervention ends. An approximate norm-dynamics recurrence captures the slow convergence of these relative steps, and fixed-norm replays of the measured trajectories reproduce the performance ordering and a similar loss difference. item.title: Deep Neural Networks Training Efficiency: Does Grokking Modify its Dynamics?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

We study whether grokking, the delayed emergence of out-of-distribution generalization after apparent overfitting, alters training efficiency in deep neural networks, where efficie

We study whether grokking, the delayed emergence of out-of-distribution generalization after apparent overfitting, alters training efficiency in deep neural networks, where efficiency is measured as accuracy per unit energy. Using two canonical settings, modular arithmetic and MNIST, we analyze two neural network models under 16-, 32-, and 64-bit precision and use Orthograd to test whether grokking produces noticeable deviations from the typically decreasing dynamics of training efficiency. We consider both short training runs of up to 500 epochs and long training runs of up to 20,000 epochs, and in both cases identify grokking as a sharp improvement in test accuracy after a sustained train-test gap. In the short-horizon experiments, applying Orthograd at progressively stronger levels during early training does not induce grokking, and efficiency remains smoothly decreasing. In the long-horizon experiments, Orthograd induces grokking, but the efficiency curves remain approximately monotonic and show no appreciable local increase at the grokking transition. These results suggest that, in our setting, grokking does not materially alter overall training-efficiency dynamics.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operation

The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. Indeed, the persistence of latent codes predicts the qualitative structure of autocorrelations and accounts for most of the empirical measures. In real text, we take sparse-autoencoder features as proxies for latent variables, and find that their persistence correlates strongly wi…

item.title: DeCompCert: A Verified Decompiler for CompCert-Generated AArch64
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：能否对 CompCert 生成的 AArch64 汇编做形式化验证的反编译，可靠还原出语义等价的 C 代码？

方法：DeCompCert 是 Rocq 验证的反编译器——通过 9 个逆向过程重构 CompCert C，结合演绎验证的变换与翻译验证；不可信的 OCaml/Datalog 分析提出候选重建，验证器只接受满足语义对应的候选；组合正确性定理保证：被接受 C 重建的每个已定义安全行为都被输入汇编匹配。

关键数字：约 216 万行 C 上评估；有精确函数与调用签名时，3,173 个合格上下文在未优化与优化流水线下全部重建重编译成功；无签名时累计推理组合验证 3,164 个中的 2,606 个（82.4%），平台+IDA 配置验证 2,407 个（76.1%）。

为什么值得看：反编译器形式化验证的里程碑，逆向工程与编译器验证交叉领域的重要进展。

原文：DeCompCert: A Verified Decompiler for CompCert-Generated AArch64

item.title: Conflict, Feasibility, Faithfulness, Displacement: Four Quantities That Come Apart in Federated Dual-Cone Aggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

FedFV, FedGH and FedMGDA+ aggregate client updates with multi-objective gradient aggregators to remove conflict between them. We examine this rationale with UPGrad, which increases

FedFV, FedGH and FedMGDA+ aggregate client updates with multi-objective gradient aggregators to remove conflict between them. We examine this rationale with UPGrad, which increases no client's loss to first order, in a comparison that changes only the direction of FedAvg's update. Four quantities the rationale treats as one -- conflict between client updates, feasibility of their weighted mean, faithfulness of the transmitted updates to the clients' gradients, and displacement of the update -- come apart. Under Dirichlet partitioning UPGrad improves CIFAR-10 accuracy by +0.78 pp (14/15 seeds, p < 0.001), only with full participation; on Oxford-IIIT Pet its +0.52 pp gain vanishes (+0.07 pp) once the data our protocol left unused are kept. Varying only the Dirichlet concentration, the gain grows with heterogeneity, yet the split with the most conflict shows none. Uniform client weights, blind to conflict, match the CIFAR-10 gain and exceed the Pets gain; a matched random rotation does neither. No fairness effect survives multiplicity correction, and on CIFAR-10 the guarantee does not reach the clients' gradients. We state what evaluations should report.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：ML 系统为负载与硬件定制计算，但通信仍停留在通用库——其设备代码与传输决策对高层编译器不可见，无法协同优化。

方法：Obaleth 编译器把 GPU 发起的通信变成 kernel 中间表示的一部分，与计算协同优化并降级为专用传输代码；围绕 buffer 生命周期规划完成时机，跨 NVIDIA/AMD GPU 优化内存序、同步与批处理。

关键数字：H100 上小消息发送最快 3.3×；256 GPU 上 all-to-all 比 NVSHMEM 快 1.25×、比 NCCL GIN 快 2.3×，内存与寄存器占用更小；vLLM 中为 16 块 B200 上的 Qwen3-235B 服务，比 DeepEP 快 1.29×。

为什么值得看：把 GPU 通信纳入编译器优化视野，大模型分布式推理的通信开销有新解法。

原文：Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking

item.title: Compiling Matrix Formulas to Quantum Block Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Realizing the promise of quantum applications such as chemistry or fluid dynamics requires building quantum circuits that efficiently encode and manipulate exponentially large matr

Realizing the promise of quantum applications such as chemistry or fluid dynamics requires building quantum circuits that efficiently encode and manipulate exponentially large matrices. This process forces researchers to grapple with the reality that a matrix expressible as one equation on paper can map to thousands of bit-level quantum logic gates, historically written by hand. Even worse, it often ends with a discovery that the needed resources grow so quickly with matrix size that the quantum algorithm loses its asymptotic speedup. In this work, we present MARBLE, a language that automatically synthesizes an efficient circuit from the publication-style formula for the entries of a matrix. MARBLE algebraically rewrites programs into symbolic combinations of simpler matrices that have known circuit realizations. It analyzes costs of possible representations, notably the subnormalization term that dominates time complexity. It then emits an OpenQASM circuit and certifies whether its cost is poly-logarithmic in problem size, as required by quantum algorithms. When evaluated on quantum applications ranging from fluid dynamics to physical Hamiltonians, MARBLE matches or surpasses 37 o…

item.title: Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed o

A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed order that nobody placed. Our companion work calls the second kind a silent error, and it is the dangerous one. We present a web demo in which a fine-tuned 0.8B parameter model runs entirely inside the visitor's browser tab, through llama.cpp compiled to WebAssembly. No order text leaves the device. The page parses orders as the visitor types, scores every ticket with the PIZZA benchmark's own matcher ported to TypeScript, refuses anything off the menu with "?" so the model can face the open web, and lets visitors hunt for silent errors or try to cause one. Run in the browser on all 1,357 PIZZA test orders, the deployed model writes the same output as the server evaluation for 99.0% of them and reaches the same exact match (0.882); we also report its latency on 3 consumer laptops. Demo: https://wrong.cuyor.com

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：agent 会话频繁编辑上下文会失效 KV cache，请求被迫等待重新 prefill 才能开始 decode，如何降低这段延迟？

方法：Callo 分离式 serving 系统——利用失效的 KV 生成投机草稿（speculative drafts），prefill 完成后对照精确 KV 验证再提交 token；在 decode 资源空闲期调度投机、草稿可能不被接受时主动抢占，提高 decode 资源利用率。

关键数字：双 GPU 测试台 + SWE-agent 会话、三个模型族，中等负载下相对 vLLM 全体请求加速 1.05–1.19×；真实 trace 驱动的集群级模拟验证收益可扩展到大规模。

为什么值得看：把「失效 KV」变废为宝做投机解码，prefill-decode 分离架构下的新优化点。

原文：Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation

item.title: CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘 AI 加速器效率受数据搬运限制，前期 CHARM 用计算与搬运重叠缓解，能否进一步用存内计算作为并行加速器、彻底消除部分数据搬运？

方法：CHARMING 异构边缘 AI 架构——基于精度与量化感知的划分，把注意力头分配到 AIE 阵列与 in-DRAM 计算单元上并发执行；按模型结构、序列长度与精度平衡负载并挑选头以最小化精度损失；把量化集成进 AIE 投影阶段进一步减少数据搬运。

关键数字：AMD Versal VCK5000 与 Alveo U200 硬件端到端验证；prefill 性能最高提升 23.6%、decode 最高 44%；int4×int4 定点存内计算下每层能耗最高降 7.6%、能耗延迟积改善最多 24.7%，精度接近 FP32 基线。

为什么值得看：AIE+存内计算并行加速的硬件实测方案，边缘 LLM/视频生成推理的新架构思路。

原文：CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation

item.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble me

Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemic decomposition in principle, but are computationally prohibitive at LLM scale and require white-box access. Existing black-box methods, in contrast, summarize to a single scalar that cannot make the distinction. We introduce a two-level ensemble that bridges this gap. Stochastic decoding of a fixed prompt forms the inner ensemble; meaning-preserving semantic perturbations of the prompt form the outer ensemble. Variability is measured in a continuous embedding space, and the law of total covariance gives an exact within-/between-perturbation decomposition to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty (AU/EU); it requires only black-box sampling access. On top of this estimator, we contribute three theoretical results that ground the framework: (i) a finite-sample bias identity for nested Monte Carlo with a closed-form bias-corrected epistemic estimator; (ii) a Bayesian bridge bounding the gap between perturbation-population AU/EU and Bayesian targets; and (iii) a sep…

item.title: Beyond Blossom: Accelerating MWPM Decoding for Surface Codes With Local Predecoding and Architecture-Aware Optimizations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) is widely used to decode surface codes, but its computational cost increases with code distance. We present Beyond Blossom, a state-of-the-ar

Minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) is widely used to decode surface codes, but its computational cost increases with code distance. We present Beyond Blossom, a state-of-the-art CPU-based MWPM decoder for surface codes. It combines algorithmic optimization through local predecoding, architecture-aware optimization, and pipeline-wide parallelism to reduce matching workload and execution overhead while preserving MWPM optimality. Across rotated surface codes with distances 9-33 and circuit-level physical error rates of 0.05%-0.3%, on a single CPU core, Beyond Blossom achieves a 4.23$\times$ geometric-mean speedup and up to 5.58$\times$ speedup over Sparse Blossom in PyMatching. At distance 33 and a physical error rate of 0.1%, with 8 CPU cores, decoding a block of 33 measurement rounds takes 21.40 $μ$s on average, equivalent to 0.65 $μ$s per round.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BPU-SpikeMM:Exact Matrix Multiplication via Spatio-Temporal Spike Encoding on Real Neuromorphic Hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Matrix multiplication is the dominant computational kernel in deep learning, yet its growing scale strains conventional von Neumann hardware in energy efficiency and bandwidth. Neu

Matrix multiplication is the dominant computational kernel in deep learning, yet its growing scale strains conventional von Neumann hardware in energy efficiency and bandwidth. Neuromorphic architectures offer a promising alternative, but mathematical equivalence between matrix multiplication and spiking computation does not guarantee direct execution on real neuromorphic hardware, as the specific hardware paradigm may still require additional data recovery, bit-weight reconstruction, or state readout after neuromorphic execution. This paper presents BPU-SpikeMM (Brain Processing Unit-based Spike Matrix Multiplication), an exact spatio-temporal spike encoding framework for matrix multiplication on real neuromorphic hardware. We prove the exact equivalence of spike-encoded matrix multiplication under the BPU execution paradigm, distinguish mathematical equivalence from native direct-readout equivalence on BPU hardware, and build a spatio-temporal offloading pipeline supporting multiple encoding schemes. Furthermore, we extend the framework to a multi-dimensional encoding design space and evaluate the applicability of different encodings on real BPU hardware in terms of correctness, …

item.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Ascend NPU 上 kernel 优化缺少面向真实负载的评测基准——现有基准侧重 kernel 生成，很少评估 agent 在真实输入配置下优化既有实现的能力。

方法：AscendGYM 基准，初始 48 个 kernel 分三档难度；每个 kernel 配的测试用例数据类型与张量形状取自真实训练/推理任务，性能提升可直接映射到对应负载；支持模型评估与 model-harness 评估两种模式，内置 harness 带搜索编排与经验积累；提出新指标 Speedup-Token Score (STS)，联合考虑加速比与 token 成本。

关键数字：48 个 kernel、三档难度、真实负载形状；STS 衡量预算内实际 kernel 优化能力；代码开源在 github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM。

为什么值得看：昇腾生态首个面向 agent 的真实负载 kernel 优化基准，做 kernel 自动调优的人值得关注。

原文：AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs

item.title: Analyzing Learning-Dynamics Across Loss and Prediction Choices for Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($\epsilon$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting ni

Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($ε$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting nine combinations are algebraically related, they can yield substantially different denoising accuracy and sample quality. We disentangle the effects of prediction and loss spaces. For a fixed prediction target, we show that changing the loss space is exactly equivalent to timestep reweighting and provide a heuristic analysis of how this reweighting affects generation quality. We then show that a rank-$m$ linear bottleneck compressing a $D$-dimensional noisy input imposes an irreducible squared-error floor of $D-m$ on noise and velocity prediction, whereas clean-data prediction can exploit low-dimensional data structure. Combining this bound with prediction-dependent error conversion yields distinct necessary conditions on bottleneck capacity. Experiments with U-Net and JiT across CIFAR-10, Imagenette, and ImageNet-256 support these theoretical predictions. Under compression, prediction choice strongly affects both denoising accuracy and sample quality, with noise-prediction errors closely matching the theoretical…

item.title: A Unified Device-Level Physical Framework for DRAM Read Disturbance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Read disturbance in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) depends on both local device interactions and the electrical conditions imposed by shared array circuitry. Here, we combine

Read disturbance in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) depends on both local device interactions and the electrical conditions imposed by shared array circuitry. Here, we combine DIMM-level characterization results, device measurements, and TCAD simulations to interpret RowHammer, RowPress, and ColumnDisturb within a unified device-level physical framework. We relate charge evolution at the floating storage node to three key mechanisms: trap-assisted electron migration (EM), capacitive coupling (CC), and sense-amplifier-mediated disturb (SAMD). EM is local and trap-sensitive, while CC weakens with wordline separation. SAMD extends disturbance through shared column circuitry by modifying unselected-cell leakage under rail-level bitline biases, a contribution supported by the approximately ninefold higher OFF-state leakage measured relative to retention-like conditions for a high-voltage storage state. These distinct spatial ranges account for localized RowHammer and RowPress failures and remote ColumnDisturb populations with abrupt changes at subarray boundaries. We further interpret prolonged RowPress activation as a transition from an initial RowHammer-like transient to sustained…

item.title: Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. Comparisons with random and magnitude-based sparse perturbations further highlight the importance of informative support selection.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Vector-Space Projection and Unified Complex-Valued Acceleration for Scaling Matrix-Based Brain-Inspired Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Symbolic reasoning at scale requires representations that are both expressive and hardware-efficient. Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) provides a promising brain-inspired framework, encoding concepts as high-dimensional vectors composed through efficient algebraic operations. However, the widely used Fourier Holographic Reduced Representation (FHRR) relies on commutative binding, which cannot encode order or directionality. Prior FPGA/ASIC accelerators recover this through costly permutation logic, incurring irregular memory access and high control overhead. Generalized Holographic Reduced Representations (GHRR) instead redefine binding as non-commutative matrix multiplication, naturally encoding sequences, graphs, and hierarchies without permutations-but at the cost of turning every element into a matrix, introducing compute and storage overhead that limits scalability. In this work, we propose a flattening methodology that preserves GHRR's matrix-based encoding while executing training and inference directly in vector space, functionally equivalent to FHRR inference yet free of permutation logic. We further design a custom 28 nm ASIC that fuses binding and similarity into a unifi…

item.title: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity s…

item.title: User-Schedulable Approximations for Quantized Tensor Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：量化让 LLM 能跑在边缘设备，但每种权重格式×激活格式×指令集都要配对 kernel，GGML 手工维护成本爆炸——54 个权重-激活配对里只有 8 个有 tiled 矩阵乘 kernel。

方法：把 Halide 的 algorithm/schedule 分离扩展到数值表示：每个近似是一个 codec（encoder+decoder），由量化器、整数表示、位打包与布局等可复用单元组合；新指令 approximate_by 把 codec 应用到一个程序阶段，encoder/decoder 变成可调度的普通阶段并与矩阵乘的寄存器 tile 融合；round-trip law 等契约用属性测试检查。

关键数字：一套算法+调度库生成 347 个 kernel，覆盖 31 种格式、38 个 GGML 无 kernel 的配对，代码量仅为 GGML+KleidiAI 的 1/3.7；Apple M3 Max 上 91.0% 的有对应 kernel 场景达到 GGML 至少 95% 速度，中位加速 1.13×；x86 AMX 移植仅 793 行、83.5% 场景匹配 GGML。

为什么值得看：量化推理 kernel 覆盖率的系统级解法，llama.cpp 生态直接受益。

原文：User-Schedulable Approximations for Quantized Tensor Programs

方法：把 Halide 的 algorithm/schedule 分离扩展到数值表示：每个近似是一个 codec（encoder+decoder），由量化器、整数表示、位打包与布局等可复用单元组合；新指令 approximate_by 把 codec 应用到一个程序阶段，encoder/decoder 变成可调度的普通阶段并与矩阵乘的寄存器 tile 融合；round-trip law 等契约用属性测试检查。

关键数字：一套算法+调度库生成 347 个 kernel，覆盖 31 种格式、38 个 GGML 无 kernel 的配对，代码量仅为 GGML+KleidiAI 的 1/3.7；Apple M3 Max 上 91.0% 的有对应 kernel 场景达到 GGML 至少 95% 速度，中位加速 1.13×；x86 AMX 移植仅 793 行、83.5% 场景匹配 GGML。

为什么值得看：量化推理 kernel 覆盖率的系统级解法，llama.cpp 生态直接受益。

item.title: Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation. To help address this, we propose and analyze a mathematical model of distillation, which suggests that distillation's performance comes not from obtaining better models but from easier to optimize landscapes. For generalized linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent, we prove that distillation fits performant student models asymptotically more quickly than non-distilled models. In rank-1 matrix approximation, we characterize conditions on the target matrix under which gradient descent with distillation converges strictly faster than training on the supervised objective. The theory helps delineate the ways distillation provides benefits (i.e., in optimization speed, not in generalization), and experiments on real datasets corroborate the theoretical predictions.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Towards Automated Recommendation of Steady-State Detection Algorithms for Software Performance Benchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Steady-state detection is a central step in software performance benchmarking, yet different detection methods rely on different assumptions and may perform best on different execution profiles. This paper formulates steady-state detection as an algorithm-recommendation problem: given a benchmark time series, predict which of two complementary detectors is more appropriate. The first, CP-SSD, identifies steady state through changepoint-based segmentation of the execution trace, whereas the second, KB-KSSD, uses a kernel-based approach to identify stable behaviour. We propose a data-driven recommender that characterises benchmark time series using automatically extracted features and combines supervised prediction with information derived from groups of time series exhibiting similar behaviour. The approach is evaluated on 407 labelled benchmark time series for which one of the two detectors can be identified as preferable with respect to a reference steady-state index. The proposed recommender selects the better detector correctly for 72.97% of the series, compared with 62.65% when always selecting the detector that performs best most often, corresponding to an absolute improvement…

item.title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. Across fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks, ci-proto XL sets a new state of the art among time series foundation models. The five ci-proto variants also make up the entire Pareto frontier for mean scaled quantile loss and mean absolute scaled error against both parameter count and median runtime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Sparse Convolution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Deep neural networks for image processing are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained edge devices such as drones, medical systems, and smartphones, where limited computational resources and memory bandwidth pose significant challenges for efficient inference. Pruning during training often produces highly sparse convolutional kernels, offering the potential to significantly reduce computation and memory requirements. However, exploiting this sparsity efficiently at runtime remains challenging due to irregular memory access patterns and workload imbalance across processing elements. In this work, we investigate the standard convolution with sparse weights and analyze its performance characteristics through roofline analysis, showing that a 3 x 3 sparse convolution achieves an arithmetic intensity of approximately 10 FLOP/byte compared to roughly 96 FLOP/byte for its dense counterpart. We propose techniques for an efficient sparse convolution at high sparsities. Preliminary results demonstrate that our approach achieves upto 1.65x speedup as compared to dense convolution on NVIDIA A100 and upto 1.52x on NVIDIA Jetson Nano (Tegra X1) , motivating further exploration of direct co…

item.title: Sustainable Federated Fine-Tuning with LoRA: Environmental Impact and Performance Footprint
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Federated Learning (FL) with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its energy and carbon costs across hardware remain poorly understood. We evaluated federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on NVIDIA A40, RTX 6000 Ada, and A100 GPUs using a $2^2$ full factorial design with 135M/360M models and 10/100 local steps. CodeCarbon tracked energy and estimated CO$_2$-equivalent emissions. Descriptive allocation of variation assigned 84.8-91.2% of energy and emissions variation to local steps within these ranges. On A40 and RTX 6000 Ada, configurations with fewer steps achieved comparable accuracy with roughly 6-8-fold lower energy consumption and higher accuracy per kWh. These findings support smaller local budgets for energy-efficient federated fine-tuning within the evaluated setting.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Smoothed Analysis for Distributed MIS
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We study smoothed analysis of the distributed Maximal Independent Set (MIS) problem. Luby's algorithm computes an MIS in $O(\log n)$ rounds, while the recent $Ω(\log n/\log\log n)$ lower bound of Khoury and Schild (2026) shows that it is nearly optimal even in the LOCAL model. We ask whether small random perturbations can overcome this worst-case barrier. Given an arbitrary base graph $G$ on $n$ nodes, we consider the smoothed graph $\mathcal{G}_s=G\triangle G(n,p)$, where $G(n,p)$ is an independent random graph and $\triangle$ denotes symmetric difference. Thus, each possible edge is independently toggled with probability $p$. We establish nearly tight bounds on the smoothing needed for faster distributed MIS. For every base graph $G$, when $p=β\ln n/n$ for a sufficiently large constant $β$, a randomized LOCAL algorithm, given only $\mathcal{G}_s$, computes an MIS of $\mathcal{G}_s$ in $O(\sqrt{\log n})$ rounds with high probability. This is almost quadratically faster than the worst-case lower bound. Conversely, if $p\le(1/2-δ)\ln n/n$ for a fixed constant $δ>0$, there exists a base graph on which every randomized LOCAL MIS algorithm requires $Ω(\log n/\log\log n)$ rounds on the …
