item.title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method. However, exact Newton methods require expensive multiplication of dense Jacobian matrices, and quasi-Newton methods based on diagonal approximations, while more scalable, are often slow to converge because they neglect interactions across state dimensions. We introduce a novel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms with diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to blocks of the Jacobian. We construct the approximations from trajectory secants, avoiding automatic differentiation while retaining the favorable scaling of diagonal approximations and remaining compatible with parallel scan through rank compression. We prove finite-step recovery of the exact trajectory under the compressed scan, and show that convergence is tracked by the compression error and by the block approximation error along the current trajectory error, rather than …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

We construct the approximations from trajectory secants, avoiding automatic differentiation while retaining the favorable scaling of diagonal approximations and remaining compatible with parallel scan through rank compression. The escalating complexity of deep neural networks hinders the deployment of federated learning (FL) on resource-constrained devices, especially for multimedia applications such as on-device image classification and speech recognition. Parallel split learning (PSL) has emerged as a promising solution by offloading a substantial portion of the computational workload to the server through layer-wise model partitioning, making it particularly suitable for resource-limited visual and speech intelligence scenarios. item.title: PARDIG: Global Precipitation Estimates Learned from Sparse Satellite Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Estimating precipitation at the global scale is vital for Earth system science and disaster response, yet observational coverage and measurement precision remain constrained. Existing solutions provide options that trade off desirable traits such as skill, latency, geographical coverage, temporal coverage, and spatial and temporal resolution. We present PARDIG, an artificial intelligence framework based on a spherical graph-mesh transformer architecture that produces near-real-time global precipitation estimates. PARDIG is trained on dense multi-modal inputs, including atmospheric state analyses and multi-spectral geostationary satellite imagery, to predict sparse, high-precision precipitation measurements from spaceborne radar. At inference, the trained model is applied densely across the globe at $0.1^\circ$ spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution, producing complete near-real-time precipitation fields from 2016 to the present, alongside a historical variant extending the record back to 1999. Evaluation against three independent radar networks (over the US, Europe, and Japan) and against over 36,000 surface stations worldwide shows that PARDIG consistently outperforms IMERG V07…

item.title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

A user utterance does not uniquely determine the next action in full-duplex dialogue: its consequences depend on the assistant's response state and interaction history. Speech activity, utterance completion, and interruption intent provide related evidence, whose implications for a response require an explicit action policy. We formulate this task at collected-segment endpoints and introduce Omni-JEV, which maps text or role-indexed user and assistant-reference speech to probabilities over five interaction actions. An aligned speech-to-speech understanding backbone encodes the acoustic roles separately and shares its candidate readout with text inputs. Bilingual weak supervision supports cross-entropy fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning for probability-sensitive decisions (RLCD). We compare Gaussian-logit and categorical Choice RLCD from the same supervised initialization under matched training exposure, observing different trade-offs between classification and probability quality. Gaussian Omni-JEV achieves test accuracies of 84.08% for audio and 96.55% for text. This common action interface supports decisions about when a full-duplex voice assistant should respond, pre…

item.title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Many-query analyses, in which a computational model is repeatedly evaluated, play an important role in uncertainty quantification and optimization for engineering design. However, many-query analyses can be prohibitively expensive when considering high-fidelity numerical models, especially those governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). Surrogate modeling replaces costly simulations with cheap approximations, enabling practical uncertainty quantification and design workflows. Machine learning (ML) approaches to surrogate modeling have gained significant traction in the development of surrogate models due to their non-intrusive nature; they do not require access to the underlying simulation code. The Operator Inference (OpInf) approach, in particular, fits reduced operators to state and corresponding time derivative data. However, high-fidelity training data is scarce due to limited computational budgets, and OpInf models trained on such scarce data often exhibit high variance, a critical liability in high-risk engineering design. We propose Multifidelity Operator Inference (MF-OpInf), which reduces this variance by supplementing scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant…

Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly composed into multi-agent workflows to accomplish complex and multi-step tasks. As the open-weight models continue to close the performance gap with the proprietary ones, model parameters are becoming a less significant source of competitive advantage in the artificial intelligence market. Yet how these models are efficiently scheduled onto distributed infrastructure such as the cloud, with respect to overall latency, monetary cost and resource utilization, remains largely unaddressed in the literature despite being an increasingly critical problem. Existing agentic workflow frameworks mostly focus on output quality and task success rates over popular benchmarks, rarely accounting for execution dynamics of LLM-based agents such as inference latency, computation power of heterogeneous resources, cloud-specific billing period and resource provisioning overheads. item.title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Smart industrial solutions that can address multiple tasks require models that understand the underlying processes. We examine representation learning for modeling the injection moulding process as an example of such solutions. We consider its data efficiency and multi-modal benefit compared to classical machine learning alternatives. To this end, we synthesize a process-informed dataset based on a real reference cycle of an Erlanger Träger part. We then introduce MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention based variational autoencoder that reconstructs in-mould signals, while classifying parts as acceptable or as one of our synthetic failure modes. We evaluate MouldIt on two tasks, known-class classification and unknown-class detection, across nine dataset sizes in single-modal and multi-modal settings. We compare it with an accept-all baseline and the classical methods k-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, random forests, and principal component analysis, which we adapt to support both tasks. item.title: Metamorphic testing of learned AC optimal power flow surrogates reveals representation dependence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating a learned AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) surrogate on one grid serialization cannot show whether its accuracy depends on that encoding. We test this dependence with thirteen metamorphic relations, each specifying when a transformation is valid and how to compare its outputs. Our audit covers 17 model and pipeline configurations: two released trained checkpoints and 15 random-weight architecture or mechanism controls. Every configuration violates at least six relations, even at reporting tolerances ten times tighter or looser. For GridSFM-Open v1.1, source inspection and intermediate-tensor interventions point to an indexing bug and three noncanonical or numerically unstable preprocessing choices; a repaired checkpoint remains untested. In a separate case500 training experiment, augmentation lowers transformed-view error in three of four models and median discrepancy and constraint-violation P95 in all four. These benefits depend on the training protocol: some relations worsen, and every evaluated prediction remains AC infeasible. A GPU/CPU eigensolver mismatch accounts for most of the large raw-Laplacian-baseline gain. We recommend reporting representation consistency al…

item.title: Massive Activations Confound Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are commonly evaluated by variance explained and ablation damage. We show how massive activations undermine both evaluations, and propose a correction. Massive activations cause up to 99.9% of activation variance to lie along the first principal component (PC1). Because the PC1 component has no unique sparse decomposition, each SAE run rebuilds it from a different set of features. These features dominate importance rankings: an average of 47 of the 50 most important features are unmatched in a separate run, compared with about 27 of a random 50. A dictionary can also report 99.96% of variance explained while leaving 33% of the variance outside PC1 unexplained. We bypass PC1 by training the SAE on activations with PC1 removed, then adding PC1 to the reconstruction. In affected models, the top-50 feature sharing rate rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%. At the same TopK sparsity, the resulting SAE degrades the model up to 44% less and reduces content reconstruction error by up to 33.9%.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.

item.title: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：训练 LLM 生成高效 CUDA kernel 需要覆盖多样化计算需求与迭代优化的监督数据，这类数据如何系统化构建？

方法：KernelMosaic 开放数据集配对多样化 CUDA 任务与可验证实现及轨迹；人类引导审查 + 多样性感知选择，任务以自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交集表达；agentic 框架引导强 LLM 完成实现、正确性修复与性能优化。

关键数字：小开源模型 SFT 后 KernelBench L1/L2/L3 正确率从 4%/0%/0% 升至 88%/82%/16%；各层级快于 PyTorch eager 的任务占比均提升；轨迹监督显著优于直接响应。

为什么值得看：为 CUDA kernel 生成提供首个大规模、带验证轨迹的监督数据集，agentic 优化闭环可直接复用。

原文：KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation

item.title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Stochastic diffusion samplers often require substantially more neural function evaluations (NFEs) than deterministic samplers to achieve comparable sample quality. Although higher-order discretization accelerates deterministic sampling, its benefits for stochastic sampling remains unclear. We establish matching upper and worst-case lower bounds showing that stochastic samplers with higher-order approximations remain first-order convergent, even with exact score functions. Thus, increasing the approximation order does not generally improve the convergence order. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce forward-value discretization, a training-free framework that evaluates the data/noise prediction model at a lookahead estimate constructed from previous predictions. For deterministic sampling, the resulting Forward DPMSolver (F-DPMSolver), improves sample quality at low NFE budgets through its DDIM-based variant, despite remaining first-order convergent. For stochastic sampling, we develop Forward DDPM (F-DDPM), which evaluates the model at a cleaner lookahead point adjusted for subsequent noise injection. item.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：并行投机解码一次前向提议整块草稿 token，但高负载下 drafting 消耗大量 step 时间且大部分被丢弃（从不被验证）；草稿与验证长度在批次内耦合，如何按请求联合分配？

方法：提出 work-conserving speculation（WCS）与原型 ForeSpark：① 上下文感知 pre-draft 估计器，从目标模型上下文特征预测各候选长度接受率；② 轻量联合草稿-验证调度器，全局排序同时选定两个长度；③ post-draft 预算分配，把验证花在最可能接受的 token 上。

关键数字：高负载下 drafting 占 step 时间高达 40%，其中大部分被丢弃；vLLM 实现上，相同每请求生成率下吞吐比 SOTA DSpark 高 1.77×、比自回归解码高 2.49×。

为什么值得看：把投机解码的草稿长度从"固定整块"变为按请求联合调度的预算分配，服务负载场景下收益显著。

原文：ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding

item.title: Federated Learning for Cross-Regional Epidemic Forecasting with Asynchronous Outbreaks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Objective: Epidemic outbreaks are often asynchronous across regions, yet collaborative forecasting is hampered by privacy laws and heterogeneous public health interventions. We developed and evaluated, as a proof of concept, a federated learning (FL) framework for cross-regional COVID-19 forecasting under asynchronous outbreaks among Guangdong, Macau, and Portugal, while maintaining data sovereignty. Methods: Using daily case data from WHO and China CDC for the three regions, whose outbreaks were asynchronous and interventions heterogeneous, we trained Long Short-Term Memory networks via FL for short-term forecasting, benchmarked against localized and centralized training using Root Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error, and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error. All experiments used the Flower FL framework with consistent hyperparameters across sites. Publicly available, aggregated case-count data were used so that the centralized benchmark could be computed as a reference. Results: The dataset comprised 1,233 daily observations (411 days) of new confirmed COVID-19 cases from November 24, 2021, to January 8, 2023. item.title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Exploiting What NVIDIA Profilers Hide: Fast and Accurate Analytical GPU Performance Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GPU 硬件配置设计空间越来越大，cycle-level 模拟器太慢，而现有解析模型需在目标配置上重估或缩放每个 warp stall，跨配置预测不准——如何快速且准确地跨配置预测性能？

方法：关键观察——固定延迟 stall 跨配置不变，排队 stall 才随各硬件单元压力变化。据此提出 ForeSight 排队解析模型：复用硬件上测得的固定延迟 stall，按单元压力重算排队 stall；配套 UnitSight profiler 恢复 NVIDIA 官方 profiler 聚合隐藏的各单元计数器。

关键数字：九款 NVIDIA GPU 硬件配置上，内核执行时间 MAPE 8.3%（最佳基线 14.1%）；vLLM LLM 推理端到端时间 MAPE 2.0%；比 cycle 级模拟器 Accel-Sim 快 49×；用 ForeSight 探索 H20 衍生配置找到 1.78× 的 LLM 推理配置。

为什么值得看：不再为每个新配置重跑模拟，基于实测 stall 复用做解析预测，误差与速度兼得。

原文：Exploiting What NVIDIA Profilers Hide: Fast and Accurate Analytical GPU Performance Modeling

item.title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. item.title: Energy-Proportional Serverless Computing on SBC Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Serverless 承诺按需运行代码，但底层服务器空闲时仍消耗大部分电力——能耗并不随负载归零。函数无状态性能否让 scale-to-zero 从函数实例扩展到物理节点？

方法：基于 tinyFaaS 在单板计算机（SBC）集群上构建平台，把节点电源状态纳入 worker 选择：空闲即断电、负载上来再开机。

关键数字：物理集群上突发型轨迹平均功耗降 39.6%、稀疏轨迹降 46.7%，突发负载中位延迟无可测变化；代价在尾部——所有 worker 关机时到达的调用需等约一分钟节点启动；持续负载下表现如常开集群。

为什么值得看：把能量成比例从实例级推到物理节点级，用函数无状态性换取集群级功耗收益，方法简单直接可复现。

原文：Energy-Proportional Serverless Computing on SBC Clusters

item.title: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. item.title: DnNP: Denoising Input Uncertainty in Neural Processes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Neural Processes (NPs) are flexible meta-learning models capable of uncertainty quantification across diverse applications. However, the standard NP framework assumes access to noise-free inputs. This is unrealistic in many practical settings, where sensor noise or measurement errors are unavoidable. This discrepancy between model assumptions and real-world data can significantly degrade prediction quality and uncertainty estimates. We introduce Denoising Neural Processes (DnNPs), a principled extension of the NP framework that explicitly models input uncertainty. We train DnNPs via variational inference. DnNPs jointly learn to denoise corrupted inputs and perform meta-learning, making them robust to noisy training data. We demonstrate DnNPs' effectiveness on both synthetic and real-world datasets, showing consistent improvements in prediction and uncertainty quantification compared to standard NPs. On PM2.5 spatial interpolation from real-world air quality sensors, DnNP reduces RMSE by up to 30% and NLL by up to 73% relative to standard NPs. We also provide theoretical grounding: we show that the Bayes-optimal predictor under noisy inputs belongs to the DnNP model class, and that …

item.title: Discovering Structurally Plausible and Interpretable Cognitive Models with Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Computational cognitive modeling has traditionally relied on manual model construction, which is a time-intensive process that requires substantial domain expertise. Although recent LLM-based approaches have begun to automate model generation, they often prioritize predictive accuracy at the expense of structural plausibility and parameter identifiability. We introduce DisCo, an LLM-guided framework that discovers interpretable symbolic cognitive models through evolutionary search with two structural components: a Validator that filters structurally invalid models, and a Cleaner that promotes parameter identifiability by removing redundant parameters. Across three behavioral tasks, DisCo consistently discovers models that achieve performance competitive with task-specific baselines. Ablation analyses show that the Validator is important for recovering psychologically meaningful structure. Without this component, models tend to violate behavioral constraints and show less consistent associations with external cognitive measures. These results suggest that LLM-driven model discovery, when coupled with appropriate structural constraints, can yield cognitively plausible models that go …

item.title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data a…

item.title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：优化后的浮点推理在不同硬件/编译器/线程数下会产生不同比特——跨环境不可复现。能否让真实模型的推理在精确整数算术下运行？

方法：开源 tritify 运行时，让真实模型（decoder-only LM、MoE decoder、Segment Anything 2.1 图像/视频栈）整个运行时前向路径走精确整数算术，浮点仅限离线量化与验证参考。三项主张逐一验证：① 跨硬件可复现（跨 CPU 指令集、跨 CPU/GPU 输出比特一致，附输出 SHA-256）；② 决策保真（整数路径复现浮点参考在测试模型与输入上的决策，OLMoE-1B-7B 与 1060 亿参数 MoE 十六层逐层保真无悬崖）；③ 位置无关（计算可跨指令集、CPU/GPU、联网机器拆分，输出比特零影响）。

关键数字：GLM-4.5-Air（106,852,251,264 参数、427GB 整数码）跨三台机器生成答案，与单主机参考比特一致——没有任何一台能单独在 RAM 中容纳其整数码。

为什么值得看：整数算术推理把"可复现"变成可验证的硬保证，支撑不信任服务器/设备群上的可验证分布式推理。

原文：Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference

方法：开源 tritify 运行时，让真实模型（decoder-only LM、MoE decoder、Segment Anything 2.1 图像/视频栈）整个运行时前向路径走精确整数算术，浮点仅限离线量化与验证参考。三项主张逐一验证：① 跨硬件可复现（跨 CPU 指令集、跨 CPU/GPU 输出比特一致，附输出 SHA-256）；② 决策保真（整数路径复现浮点参考在测试模型与输入上的决策，OLMoE-1B-7B 与 1060 亿参数 MoE 十六层逐层保真无悬崖）；③ 位置无关（计算可跨指令集、CPU/GPU、联网机器拆分，输出比特零影响）。

关键数字：GLM-4.5-Air（106,852,251,264 参数、427GB 整数码）跨三台机器生成答案，与单主机参考比特一致——没有任何一台能单独在 RAM 中容纳其整数码。

为什么值得看：整数算术推理把"可复现"变成可验证的硬保证，支撑不信任服务器/设备群上的可验证分布式推理。

原文：Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference

item.title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model's pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG-II provides ordinary Bash access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling the policy to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory across context replacements. We also introduce Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II (CAMP-II), which trains a single policy jointly across all five environments with fully asynchronous OP…

item.title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. item.title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug for…

item.title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. item.title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 更新后能否直接复用旧模型的 KV 缓存避免重复计算共享上下文？权重变化后缓存究竟保留了什么？

方法：研究四次模型更新间的直接缓存复用，重点案例 DeepSeek-V4-Flash→Flash-0731；提出 Functional Cache Divergence（比较复用与原生缓存下的 next-token 分布）刻画行为差异；用 answer-margin 分析解释正确检索决策如何在内部状态大变下存活。

关键数字：检索准确率跨更新差异很大（近原生到大损失不一）；已有源缓存时，三个长前缀 QA benchmark 上复用达到中位 TTFT 加速 2.10-5.08×；自然文本续写下复用更忠实原生行为，而单 token 检索任务中兼容性随前缀长度增长下降；首 token 一致也不保证答案内容或停止行为一致。

为什么值得看：首次区分"任务效用"与"原生推理保真度"两个判据，为跨版本 KV 缓存复用策略提供实证依据。

原文：Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study

item.title: CAFIN: CUDA-accelerated Adaptive Fisher Information Matrix Network Optimization via GPU-Native Kernel Fusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Second-order optimizers improve deep neural network training using curvature information, but their practical efficiency is limited by GPU execution overhead. AdaFisher reduces Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) approximation costs through diagonal Kronecker structures and exponential moving averages, yet its PyTorch implementation requires sequential CUDA kernel launches, intermediate tensor allocations, and repeated memory accesses. We introduce CAFIN, a GPU-native CUDA kernel fusion framework that improves AdaFisher execution efficiency without changing its optimization formulation. The proposed approach progressively integrates FIM preconditioner construction, exponential moving average updates, gradient preconditioning, momentum accumulation, weight decay, and parameter updates into fused CUDA kernels. Shared-memory reuse, register-resident computation, and in-place operations further reduce memory traffic and intermediate allocations. Experiments using ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti and RTX 3060 Laptop GPUs demonstrate up to 78.4% lower isolated FIM construction latency and 2.1-26.9% lower optimizer-step latency. The implementation …

item.title: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefix-cached agent 服务在相同基础负载下，几分钟的额外到达就可能导致服务器进入持续降级区（命中率暴跌、吞吐减半、backlog 持续增长）——这种亚稳态是否真实存在、能否预测与恢复？

方法：对 vLLM 做对照实验：相同基础负载 + 短突发 vs 无突发孪生服务器；提出一阶工作负载平衡条件刻画降级区可排空边界；测试准入节流、挂起已准入会话（基于容量上限）、CPU offload 与预算器四种恢复/预防策略。

关键数字：突发后 vLLM 进入约 10% 命中率、约一半吞吐、backlog 增长 70 分钟的降级区，9/12 对中无突发孪生保持健康、无反向案例；Qwen3-32B 与 SGLang 上也复现（后者容忍更大触发）；准入节流仅恢复 7 个塌陷运行中的 1 个，容量上限挂起准入则几分钟内全部恢复；预算器在所有测试运行中阻止了故障。

为什么值得看：揭示 agent 服务缓存经济性的隐藏脆弱点——"缓存一旦崩塌会自我强化"，恢复策略实证可操作。

原文：Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving

item.title: Bootstrapped On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language models by distilling teacher predictions on student-generated trajectories, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes the need for an external teacher by using a reference-conditioned copy of the model as the teacher. Despite its great early improvements, we find that OPSD does not remain consistently effective under continued training and can eventually suffer substantial performance degradation. We study this training behavior and link the degradation to a growing mismatch between the evolving reference-free student and the frozen privileged teacher. In the early stage of OPSD, the privileged teacher remains closely aligned with the student and provides useful guidance for improving the student's generation trajectories. However, as training progresses, the growing distributional mismatch between the privileged teacher and reference-free student can cause the teacher to provide misleading supervision, ultimately degrading student performance. This phenomenon motivates us to first leverage privileged reference supervision to acquire useful knowledge and then transfer it to a fresh student. We introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Di…

item.title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all …

item.title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). item.title: An Asynchronous Federated Learning Platform for Lung Adenocarcinoma Grading via Foundation Models and Structural Pruning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. item.title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models. Diffusion models can amortize this computation offline, but largely data-driven conditional models underutilize known physics and suffer from ill-conditioned transport maps when the target distribution is concentrated. Plug-and-play (PnP) methods explicitly leverage the physical model to guide a learned prior, improving data consistency but reintroducing costly iterative computations. We instead propose AdjointFlow, a framework built on stochastic interpolants that injects the known physics into the generative transport itself. We design a data-dependent, adjoint-based initialization to reduce transport distance to the target, modify the transport velocity to remain regular as the endpoint distributions concentrate, and parameterize the network to build the initialization directly into the learned velocity. Together, these enable accurate reconstruction at substantially lower cost than generative models starting from Gaussian noise. Experime…

item.title: A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging (MaLoRA)
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LoRA 除参数高效外，实践中还表现出对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性和独立 adapter 可合并性——这两个对持续学习与多任务学习至关重要的性质，理论上一直缺乏解释。

方法：在近正交任务区间 + ℓ2 正则的多类线性分类下，用统一"边际视角"分析 LoRA：刻画各正则区间的最优 adapter；证明中间正则区间下最优 adapter 对齐微调数据的最大边际解；由此导出预训练/微调数据上的边际闭式表达式，揭示正则参数控制保留-适应平衡；并分析 adapter 合并，证明合并模型在每个任务上获得正边际、导出最优混合系数，给出免训练的合并规则。

关键数字：理论推导给出合并模型每任务正边际与跨任务边际最大化的最优混合系数闭式解。

为什么值得看：首次给 LoRA 两大经验性质以统一理论解释，附带免训练合并规则，直接服务多任务 adapter 组合。

原文：A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging

item.title: XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. item.title: Why Kubernetes Cannot Contain a Full Lazy-Pulling Cache: Two Impossibility Results and a Bounded, Honest Design for Model Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Lazy container-image pulling makes cold starts of autoscaled model-serving fleets on Kubernetes nearly independent of model size, but it moves the model's bytes into a node-level cache that the platform neither bounds nor accounts for. This article establishes, by experiment, two impossibility results for that cache. A monitoring-side remedy cannot catch its failure: a sentinel readiness probe stays green while 272 of 280 files are unreadable. A platform-side remedy cannot contain it: kubelet, given full disk-pressure visibility, frees 0 bytes and evicts 26 bystander pods, because its reclamation actuator is keyed to an accounting that does not know the cache exists. The article then eliminates the failure class inside the component that owns the bytes, with no change to kubelet or the container runtime interface, by two design rules: a byte budget whose pressure signal is keyed to filesystem truth, so that a never-blocking, lossy accounting still enforces a hard bound (held against about 301,000 dropped updates), and pass-through semantics under which a failed cache write never becomes a failed read, with the coupling traced to a single io.MultiWriter. item.title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $τ^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. item.title: When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Practitioners often combine independently trained models while keeping their weights frozen. These experts are commonly combined through their final predictions, although their internal features may retain useful information that those predictions omit. We ask when combining features improves on combining predictions, and how to make that comparison fair. We introduce a reusable evaluation protocol, apply it to 21 frozen deepfake detectors from DF40 (Yan et al., 2024), and audit how evaluation choices change the conclusions. The protocol uses strong prediction baselines, compares simple and larger feature combiners, varies architecture and training data separately, and reports results by held-out generator with train/test overlap controls. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, logistic regression on the features of six architecture-diverse experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best tested prediction combiner in each fold, with gains on seven of eight generators. The larger network shows no clear improvement over the linear model (approximately 3.5M versus 10K parameters), suggesting that access to richer information matters more than additional combiner capacity on thi…

item.title: What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低精度预训练通常以验证损失评判，但验证损失匹配时，罕见事实的学习效率是否也一致？论文用受控曝光次数的合成传记数据，从零训练模拟 4-bit 矩阵乘法的 transformer，检验低精度格式的真实代价。

方法 对比 NVFP4 与 BF16 在相同验证损失下的罕见事实召回所需曝光次数；进一步用零均值梯度噪声分解量化代价来源，并测试提高学习率能否补偿。

关键数字 NVFP4 需 1.32× 与 1.52× 曝光次数才达到 BF16 的召回（验证损失仅差 0.5% 与 2%）；主读数下曝光代价约 1.2×；BF16 checkpoint 的梯度统计可无拟合排序各格式代价（Spearman 0.96）。

为什么值得看 提示仅看损失曲线会高估低精度预训练，罕见事实习得应作为独立指标纳入评测。

item.title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rat…

item.title: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). item.title: Two-Tier Task Offloading for Satellite-Assisted Marine Networks: A Hybrid Stackelberg-Bargaining Game Approach
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The proliferation of maritime activities has spurred the emergence of numerous computation-intensive and delay-sensitive marine applications and services. Given the inherent rationality, selfish nature, and limited computational abilities of marine devices, devising effective strategies to incentivize their participation in task processing become a critical challenge. In this paper, we investigate the satellite-assisted marine multi-access edge computing (MEC) and propose a two-tier task offloading scheme through a hybrid Stackelberg-Bargaining game approach to enhance offloading efficiency and maximize the utility of marine devices. Specifically, for the underwater acoustic communication, we consider the scenario where multiple autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), managed by maritime autonomous surface ships (MASSs), upload their collected data using non-orthogonal multiple access(NOMA) to optimize channel utilization. item.title: Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. item.title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 一个模型接管另一模型的对话通常须重读全部历史；KV cache 翻译把源 cache 映射成目标自身格式，使目标从完整上下文继续而无需重读——对 GQA 已可行，但开源前沿模型如今缓存压缩潜变量（MLA）、稀疏注意力索引器 key 与定长线性注意力状态。

方法 复现 KV-Lingo 于 GQA 对，再为每类对象给出捕获/注入位置与达到原生质量的机制：MLA 潜变量用逐 token 线性映射翻译；循环状态用闭式校正复制或用目标自身循环重放合成；研究 16–48B 规模两个混合对的双向翻译（Kimi-VL-A3B ↔ Kimi-Linear-48B、Qwen3.5-27B ↔ Qwen3.8-27B）加稀疏注意力目标。

关键数字 从源层 0 MLA 潜变量解码 token id 使 needle 召回从 0.09 升至 2–32K 的 0.99、64K 的 0.83–1.00（最长训练 prompt 的 8 倍）；混合全 MLA 方向每个任务指标都在原生质量配对置信区间内；64K token 时首 token 时间比重读短 18.7x 与 46.8x。

为什么值得看 把 KV 翻译从 GQA 推进到 MLA/线性注意力/稀疏索引器混合架构，为模型间无缝交接对话提供完整配方。

item.title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Transmitting LoRA adapters to rollout workers can bottleneck distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks. Lowering the training rank may limit the capacity a workload needs, while adaptive optimizer updates are difficult to compress. Rollout workers can instead reconstruct updates from gradients by maintaining replicated optimizer states. We introduce HiLo, a compressor-agnostic framework that replaces parameter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay. By applying the same decoded gradients, the learner and workers maintain consistent policy states at the same version under reproducible execution. We further develop Spar, a budget-aware gradient compressor that combines spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation and error feedback to decouple training rank from communication cost. Experiments across on-policy distillation and reward-guided post-training show that HiLo with Spar maintains learning quality close to full synchronization while transmitting as little as 1.6% of the adapter bytes, and accelerates end-to-end updates by up to $2.2\times$ under bandwidth constraints.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: To SIMD or Not to SIMD: Comparing RVV vs. CGRA SoCs for Non-Linear Functions in AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 非线性函数是 LLM 中的重要操作类别，但芯片厂商一直用传统向量/标量单元处理，其性能跟不上几乎所有厂商都配备的矩阵乘单元（MMU）；FPGA/CGRA 等可重构单元缺乏与 MMU 搭配的传统单元的系统比较。

方法 构建两个 SoC：RVV 向量处理器 SoC 与延迟不敏感（elastic）CGRA SoC，均配 MMU 与单核 CPU 驱动；为常见前馈网络提出映射，系统对比两类方案。

关键数字 CGRA 在简单逐点非线性（如 SiLU）激活阶段相对 RVV 最高快 7.12x 时钟周期；RVV 在复杂非线性（如 softmax）上相对 CGRA 最高快 9.8x；在完整前馈块上对应最大值分别为 3.16x 与 4.24x。

为什么值得看 首次系统对比 RVV 与 CGRA 处理非线性函数的差异，结论「简单函数 CGRA、复杂函数 SIMD」对 AI SoC 单元选型有直接参考。

item.title: TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. item.title: Structured Kernel Surrogate Models for Multimodal Attribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study the problem of cross-sample modality attribution, which involves measuring how one modality in one sample affects the learning outcome in other multimodal samples. This problem is crucial in a multimodal system because a data modality (such as a text description) may be redundant for one sample (a self-explanatory image), but the same data modality would otherwise be uniquely informative for another sample, or informative when combined with other modalities. Prior work focuses on influence estimation at the level of one sample, and it remains an open question how one should capture the interactions across both samples and modalities. To capture scenarios like the above, we propose structured kernel surrogate models, which are surrogate mappings from both samples and modalities to the prediction outcome when they are trained together. We design an algorithm, SKS, which applies kernel ridge regression with a structured, compositional kernel on the selection states of individual samples and modalities. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning large-scale foundation models across resource-constrained, distributed clients presents significant computational and communication challenges. While merging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Federated Learning (FL) enables rank-based flexibility, the interdependence of the adaptation matrices ($\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$) often complicates optimization. In this work, we theoretically demonstrate that LoRA fine-tuning with Gaussian initialization and a frozen $\mathbf{A}$ matrix acts as a stochastic approximation of full fine-tuning, where batch gradients are subject to a random, rank-dependent perturbation. Motivated by this insight, we propose freezing and periodically resampling $\mathbf{A}$ matrices at the client level. This strategy decouples the $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ gradients, diminishes LoRA low-rank constraints and reduces both computational and uplink communication overheads by 50\%, allowing for the reallocation of resources toward higher adaptation ranks. item.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised…

item.title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at this https URL.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. item.title: Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs. item.title: Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $\gamma$ and introduce $\gamma$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. item.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GP…

item.title: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：per-step 模型路由器为 agent 的每次 LLM 调用动态选最优模型，但每次切换都丢弃前缀缓存复用（KV 缓存按模型隔离，新模型须重新 prefill）——如何让切换不再付全量 prefill 代价？

方法：SHADOWPREFILL 在路由器未选中的模型上预填会话上下文，利用正常流量实例的空闲容量，使下次切换时前缀已缓存。它收割在途请求的每迭代 SLO 余量、保护被路由调用、把影子 KV 溢写到宿主内存，影子不完整时回退冷切换。

关键数字：生产 coding-agent 轨迹（平均上下文 63K token）下，切换后前缀命中率从 80-89% 掉到 44-65%、切换调用慢 1.5-3.2×；SHADOWPREFILL 用 LLMRouter 路由 24 对模型，切换调用延迟降 8.5-21.4%、LLM 调用延迟降 3.7-17.7%、路由 token 成本降 22.5-46.1%，正常流量 SLO 与每请求能耗基本不变（+0.4%）。

为什么值得看：agentic 服务里模型路由的隐藏成本被系统化解决，复用空闲算力换缓存命中，收益明确。

原文：SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving

item.title: Resetting-based designated information distribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

For a network of $n$ nodes under random gossip dynamics, we show that by introducing the additional resetting mechanism (with rate $β$) to a designated subset of $r$ nodes, the expected sum of all node values is asymptotically equal to $\tfrac{n}{r}$ times the sum of the initial values of the $r$ designated nodes, in the small-$β$ and long-time limit. We also analyze the convergence speed to this asymptotic state and provide an approximate high-probability confidence interval for the expected sum at finite time $t$ and finite $β$. Operationally, we propose a protocol that distributes the initial node values over the designated subset evenly (up to a prescribed precision), by appropriately turning on and off the resetting dynamics. Our work not only offers insights into classical problems such as distributed computing and network control, but also serves as a potential foundation for designing quantum algorithms that prepare desired states in quantum networks using only local operations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Release Sooner, Expose Less: Offloading MoE Dispatch in NCCL-EP under Dual-Batch Overlap
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 双微批重叠（DBO）把 MoE 通信藏到另一微批计算之后，但只有 dispatch 发送释放 GPU 后才生效——dispatch 发送占用 GPU 的时间因此暴露，而释放后的网络推进可被隐藏。

方法 在 NCCL-EP 上评估三种针对暴露通信时间的研究配置：GPI（GPU 构造 GPU-Friendly Descriptors 并提交到 NIC 可访问内存传输）、GPI-MC（单个 GFD 描述 MoE token 扇出）、GDAKI Free Flow（把发送推进移到主机线程）。

关键数字 GB300 NVL72 上三种方法在多数参数扫描工作点降低 dispatch-send 时间；send 与 receive 间插入 32–512 微秒计算可隐藏延迟推进；分离式 vLLM serving 中相对 NCCL-EP 默认 GDAKI 中位 TPOT 降 15–25%，相对 DeepEP v1 降 16–42%。

为什么值得看 聚焦 DBO 下被忽视的 dispatch 暴露时间，给出三种可落地的 offload 方案与量化收益。

item.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Generative recommendation (GR) is moving industrial recommender systems (RecSys) from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. This shift promises higher recommendation quality, but makes serving substantially harder: each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. GR not only creates structural mismatches with conventional RecSys pipelines, but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of LLM serving stacks, making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. We present RecoGEM, our production GR serving system. RecoGEM uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move GR-specific serving responsibilities, such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates, to a dedicated runtime. Its execution engine exploits GR's short token sequences, large candidate populations, and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention, candidate selection, and execution planning. RecoGEM has been deployed for over nine months across our production lines, serving applications with hundreds of millions of users and s…

item.title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Ranking large language models (LLMs) through human evaluations is essential for downstream decision-making. Because human feedback is expensive, evaluation platforms often collect it adaptively, prioritizing informative model comparisons using previously observed feedback. To further improve precision with limited human feedback, evaluators can draw on abundant unrated responses and relatively inexpensive LLM judges; however, judge bias and adaptive dependence challenge standard i.i.d. inference frameworks. We propose Prediction-Powered Ranking (PP-Rank), a framework that combines LLM-judge predictions with human feedback to improve precision while providing valid inference under adaptive sampling. Data-driven prediction weights minimize the asymptotic covariance trace within the proposed class. In theory, we establish asymptotic normality for general evaluation targets and simultaneous ranking inference. A joint martingale analysis handles dependence between adaptive human feedback and auxiliary data. item.title: PegasusAI Studio: Legible Cyberinfrastructure and Accountable AI Agents for Scientific Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

AI coding agents can now construct scientific workflows, but operating them on shared cyberinfrastructure (CI) raises problems that code generation does not solve. Agents need current knowledge of the workflow system and its execution sites and access to the runtime state of distributed executions, while facilities need to attribute every agent action to a user and bound it by that user's privileges. We present PegasusAI Studio, an AI-assisted science gateway built on the Pegasus and HTCondor stack. Studio makes CI legible to agents by projecting one facility-curated knowledge base into the native configuration of several coding agents, by introspecting workflow interfaces and execution sites, and by grounding diagnosis in workflow and scheduler telemetry. Agent actions operate within a trust envelope that combines federated authentication, per-user execution environments and scheduler credentials, provider-neutral model access, observability, and approval controls for state-changing actions. The same application runs as a JupyterHub-based gateway on a research cloud and as an Open OnDemand application on HPC systems. We evaluate Studio through case studies of legacy CASA weather w…

item.title: Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

item.title: OverlapAdvisor: Modeling and Adapting Computation-Communication Overlap for Distributed MoE Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 专家并行（EP）的 MoE 推理依赖 All-to-All 通信，计算-通信重叠策略至关重要，但没有任何策略普遍最优——103 个生产配置、不同输入长度与四类硬件上，最快策略随模型形状、EP 度、输入长度与硬件变化。

方法 提出 OverlapAdvisor：用两种粒度建模重叠阶段以刻画计算-通信依赖，构建统一性能模型（计入峰值计算/内存/通信性能的偏差），支持两个 serving 引擎内的启动时、配置感知策略选择。

关键数字 四个 MoE 模型（30B–235B）对三个基线：内核级平均 1.16x、最高 1.59x 加速，预测 MAPE 3.3%–15.9%；SGLang/vLLM 端到端吞吐最高提升 31.7%；对 DeepEP-v1 与 FlashMoE 的中位加速分别为 1.10x 与 1.22x。

为什么值得看 用数据证明「无普遍最优」并给出配置感知选择模型，直接提升生产 MoE serving 的吞吐。

item.title: Optimal Proximity Black Hole Search with Programmable Matter
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The concept of programmable matter (PM) envisions objects composed of tiny, mobile particles capable of self-arrangement, which allows them to change shape, color, and move. We initiate the study of the Black Hole Search problem within the context of PM. The problem involves a dangerous and unnoticeable location, the black hole, that, without a trace, destroys any particle visiting it. In our setting, particles move inside a convex area embedded in a triangular grid, where one vertex is a black hole. The objective is for the particles to identify a restricted set of vertices containing the black hole while ensuring that at least one particle survives. We present an algorithm utilizing three particles capable of assuming just two colors to identify the dangerous region where the black hole resides. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this algorithm is Pareto optimal in terms of number of particles and number of colors required, and asymptotically optimal in terms of number of epochs, where an epoch refers to the minimal time window within which each particle completed an activation cycle at least once.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
